spec_cite: docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §4.4 (validation table: capabilities duplicated or not ascending -> 401)
docs/wire-protocol-v2/pairing.md §6.3 (canonical form: ascending numeric order, unique)
description: A Negotiate whose capabilities list is not in ascending numeric order ([2, 1]) is malformed: Error(401)+Close(401).
preconditions: Session authenticated; state NEGOTIATING (request_id 2 follows the auth exchange's 1).
assertions: The canonical form exists only for a list that is already unique and ascending numeric order (count(u8) || id(u32 BE), pairing.md §6.3); [2, 1] has none, so the list is malformed.
The frame decoded to a known message, so Error echoes request_id 2.
Fatal: Error+Close, connection torn down (spec §4.4 validation table).
